THE HIGH COURT OF MEGHALAYA
SHILLONG
NOTIFICATION
Dated Shillong the 31 ;t October, 2025
No.HCM.II1/49/2023/JudI.1/19 : in supersession of this Registry’s Notification No
HCM.II1/49/2023/JudI./18dated 08.10.2025, Hon’ble the Chief Justice, High Court of
Meghalaya, in exercise of the powers under Section 5 of The Commercial Courts Act, 2015, is
pleased to re-constitute the Commercial Appellate Division of the High Court of Meghalaya,
which shall now comprise of Hon’ble the Chief Justice and Hon’ble Mr. Justice H.S
Thangkhiew, for the purpose of exercising jurisdiction and powers conferred on it by the said
Act
By Order,
